name: Mitsui-Soko Holdings Co Ltd
summary: MITSUI-SOKO HOLDINGS Co., Ltd., together with its affiliated entities, delivers an extensive array of logistics solutions both within Japan and internationally. The company's business activities are organized into two primary divisions: Logistics and Real Estate. The Logistics segment provides a wide spectrum of services, encompassing warehousing and cargo management, port-related operations and transport, global logistics, integrated multimodal forwarding, air freight forwarding, comprehensive third-party logistics (3PL), supply chain optimization support, and domestic land transportation. The Real Estate division is dedicated to offering property leasing services. Additionally, the company oversees container terminals that link sea and land distribution networks at key Japanese ports, including Tokyo, Yokohama, Nagoya, Yokkaichi, Osaka, Kobe, and Moji. It also manages vessel arrival and departure procedures, functions as a ship agent by issuing crucial documents like cargo certificates, and executes conventional shipping duties, such as advising on the most effective handling methods for diverse types of goods. Established in 1909 and headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, the company was formerly known as Mitsui-Soko Co., Ltd. before rebranding to MITSUI-SOKO HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. in October 2014.
